name: th108-lighting-daemon
description: Always-on host-driven lighting for the Epomaker TH108 V2 PRO (pulsing cyan + keypress-reactive orange), type-anywhere via a global keyboard hook.
_comment_dependencies: EXACT versions, no ^ ranges. Two of these (node-hid, uiohook-napi) ship native binaries that read your keyboard, so 'whatever npm resolves today' is not an acceptable answer for what lands on someone's disk. setup.cmd runs `npm ci`, which installs strictly from package-lock.json - these pins make the declared versions match the locked ones, so nothing floats even if someone runs plain `npm install`. Bump deliberately, one at a time.
